## Description and Rationale

I'm Jan, manager for the A-CDM at Schiphol. I'm an engineer who previously worked for the Dutch ANSP on innovation and think that we can do a lot more with the data we already have. In operations I can see everyday the impact of predicted times being off, so I am very interested to see what is possible with open-source data and what other teams come up with.
